tasks.name: calibration_direct_set_x
tasks.prompt: Set x to A. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: calibration_conditional_set_x
tasks.prompt: If x is EMPTY, set x to A. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: calibration_replacement_x
tasks.prompt: Change x from A to B. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_direct_set_y
tasks.prompt: Set y to C. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_direct_set_x
tasks.prompt: Set x to R. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_conditional_set_y
tasks.prompt: If y is B, set y to C. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_conditional_set_x
tasks.prompt: If x is Q, set x to R. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_replacement_y
tasks.prompt: Change y from C to D. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_replacement_x
tasks.prompt: Change x from M to N. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.
